```{r setup}
rm(list = ls())
source("tracks/first-draft-may2026/code/common_first_draft.R")

# ---- Toggles ----------------------------------------------------------------
save_tables <- FALSE
```

```{r load}
master_parts <- Sys.glob(file.path(data_dir, "master_bank_zip_year_*_part*.rds"))
dates        <- regmatches(master_parts, regexpr("\\d{8}", master_parts))
latest_date  <- max(dates)
master_parts <- sort(master_parts[dates == latest_date])

dt <- rbindlist(lapply(master_parts, readRDS))
```

```{r prep}
# Mirror 06_publishable_tables_20260508.qmd prep verbatim so the descriptive
# sample matches the regression sample.
setorder(dt, RSSDID, zip5, yr)
dt[, n_branches_lag1    := shift(n_branches_bzt,    1L), by = .(RSSDID, zip5)]
dt[, bank_in_state_lag1 := shift(bank_in_state_bzt, 1L), by = .(RSSDID, zip5)]
dt[, share_bzt_lag1     := shift(share_bzt,         1L), by = .(RSSDID, zip5)]
dt[, opening := as.integer(n_branches_bzt > n_branches_lag1)]

dt[, n_large_banks_zip      := sum(n_branches_bzt > 0L), by = .(yr, zip5)]
dt[, n_large_banks_zip_lag1 := shift(n_large_banks_zip, 1L), by = .(RSSDID, zip5)]

dt[, g_dep_zip_t1_t3 := log1p(dep_zip_total_lag1) - log1p(dep_zip_total_lag3)]
dt[, g_hmda_t1_t3    := log1p(hmda_amt_lag1)      - log1p(hmda_amt_lag3)]
dt[, g_cra_t1_t3     := log1p(cra_amt_lag1)       - log1p(cra_amt_lag3)]
dt[, log_dep_zip_lag1    := log1p(dep_zip_total_lag1)]
dt[, log_avg_agi_lag1    := log(avg_agi_lag1)]
dt[, log_n_branches_lag1 := log1p(n_branches_lag1)]
dt[, hhi_lag1            := deposit_hhi_zip_lag1 / 10000]
dt[is.na(share_bzt_lag1), share_bzt_lag1 := 0]

# Raw counterparts of the logged controls.  Regressions still use the log
# versions; descriptive table reports the raw scale to be human-readable.
# log_pop_density_lag1 was built as log(population_density) (not log1p), so
# exp() recovers the raw density.
dt[, pop_density_lag1   := exp(log_pop_density_lag1)]
dt[, dep_zip_total_lag1_bn := dep_zip_total_lag1 / 1e9]

dt[!is.na(int_exp_assets_share_undercut),
   high_IEA := as.integer(int_exp_assets_share_undercut > 0.5)]
dt[!is.na(rate_paying_adv),
   high_rate_paying := as.integer(rate_paying_adv > 0)]

dt[, size_bucket := assign_bucket(bank_assets)]
```

```{r filter}
ar_master <- dt[
  yr <= 2024L                        &
  !is.na(size_bucket)                &
  !is.na(n_branches_lag1)            &
  !is.na(bank_in_state_lag1)         &
  !is.na(n_large_banks_zip_lag1)     &
  !is.na(g_dep_zip_t1_t3)            &
  !is.na(g_hmda_t1_t3)               &
  !is.na(g_cra_t1_t3)                &
  !is.na(log_dep_zip_lag1)           &
  !is.na(log_avg_agi_lag1)           &
  !is.na(log_pop_density_lag1)       &
  !is.na(median_age_lag1)            &
  !is.na(pct_college_educated_lag1)  &
  !is.na(hhi_lag1)                   &
  !is.na(no_bank_zip_lag1)
]
```

```{r buckets}
d_big <- copy(ar_master[size_bucket == "ge_100bn"])
d_mid <- copy(ar_master[size_bucket == "10_100bn"])
d_sml <- copy(ar_master[size_bucket == "1_10bn"])

# Same within-yr winsorization as 06.
for (d in list(d_big, d_mid, d_sml)) {
  d[, g_dep_zip_t1_t3           := winsor(g_dep_zip_t1_t3),           by = yr]
  d[, g_hmda_t1_t3              := winsor(g_hmda_t1_t3),              by = yr]
  d[, g_cra_t1_t3               := winsor(g_cra_t1_t3),               by = yr]
  d[, median_age_lag1           := winsor(median_age_lag1),           by = yr]
  d[, pct_college_educated_lag1 := winsor(pct_college_educated_lag1), by = yr]
  # Winsorize key RHS on the rows where the regression actually uses them
  # (06 winsors deposit_beta on d_*_b = subset where deposit_beta is finite,
  # then re-uses that table for cross-sell etc; for descriptive stats we
  # winsor in place where finite so reported moments line up).
  d[!is.na(deposit_beta)    & is.finite(deposit_beta),
    deposit_beta    := winsor(deposit_beta),    by = yr]
  d[!is.na(rate_paying_adv) & is.finite(rate_paying_adv),
    rate_paying_adv := winsor(rate_paying_adv), by = yr]
}
```

```{r vars}
# Descriptive table reports raw-scale moments for variables that the
# regression uses in logs.  Replace the four logged controls in
# `base_controls` with their raw counterparts here.
log_to_raw <- c(
  log_dep_zip_lag1    = "dep_zip_total_lag1_bn",
  log_avg_agi_lag1    = "avg_agi_lag1",
  log_pop_density_lag1= "pop_density_lag1",
  log_n_branches_lag1 = "n_branches_lag1"
)
desc_controls <- ifelse(base_controls %in% names(log_to_raw),
                        log_to_raw[base_controls],
                        base_controls)

desc_vars_keyrhs <- c(
  # LHS
  "opening",
  # Key RHS — only variables that enter the regressions in 06.
  # rate_paying_adv enters as the binary `high_rate_paying`; IEA enters as
  # the binary `high_IEA`; mortgage / CRA enter as `*_presence` indicators.
  # The continuous `rate_paying_adv`, `int_exp_assets_share_undercut`,
  # `mortgage_share`, and `cra_share` are not used as regressors and are
  # therefore omitted.
  "deposit_beta",
  "high_rate_paying", "high_IEA",
  "mortgage_presence", "cra_presence"
)

# Big bucket gets the full set (LHS + key RHS + controls).  Mid / small
# buckets show only LHS + key RHS to keep the panel compact.
desc_vars_big <- c(desc_vars_keyrhs, desc_controls)

# Friendly labels.  var_labels covers most; add any that are missing.
extra_labels <- c(
  opening             = "Branch opening (0/1)",
  high_rate_paying    = "Rate-paying advantage (binary)",
  high_IEA            = "IEA undercut $> 0.5$ (binary)",
  mortgage_share      = "Mortgage market share, t-1",
  cra_share           = "CRA small-biz county share, t-1",
  dep_zip_total_lag1_bn = "Zip total deposits (\\$B), t-1",
  avg_agi_lag1        = "Avg AGI (\\$000), t-1",
  pop_density_lag1    = "Zip pop density (000s per sq km), t-1",
  n_branches_lag1     = "Bank's branches in zip, t-1"
)
label_lookup <- c(extra_labels, var_labels)  # extras win on collision
get_label <- function(v) {
  lab <- label_lookup[v]
  if (is.na(lab) || is.null(lab) || !nzchar(lab)) v else unname(lab)
}
```

```{r helpers}
# One row of summary stats for a single variable in a single data.table.
desc_stats_one <- function(d, vars) {
  rows <- lapply(vars, function(v) {
    if (!v %in% names(d)) return(NULL)
    x <- d[[v]]
    x <- x[!is.na(x) & is.finite(x)]
    if (length(x) == 0L) return(NULL)
    qs <- quantile(x, probs = c(0.10, 0.50, 0.90), na.rm = TRUE,
                   names = FALSE, type = 7)
    data.table(
      Variable = get_label(v),
      Mean     = sprintf("%.3f", mean(x)),
      SD       = sprintf("%.3f", sd(x)),
      P10      = sprintf("%.3f", qs[1]),
      Median   = sprintf("%.3f", qs[2]),
      P90      = sprintf("%.3f", qs[3]),
      N        = format(length(x), big.mark = ",")
    )
  })
  rbindlist(rows, use.names = TRUE, fill = TRUE)
}

# Emit a tabular block (no \begin{table} wrapper) + a markdown twin.
emit_desc_panel <- function(stats_dt, file_stem) {
  md  <- knitr::kable(stats_dt, format = "pipe", row.names = FALSE,
                      align = "lrrrrrr")
  out_md <- file.path(tables_dir, paste0(file_stem, ".md"))
  writeLines(as.character(md), out_md)
  cat("Wrote:", out_md, "\n")

  if (isTRUE(save_tables)) {
    # Build a bare \begin{tabular}...\end{tabular} block by hand so we don't
    # depend on knitr's booktabs packaging.  Columns: Variable + 6 numeric.
    header <- "\\begin{tabular}{lrrrrrr}\n\\toprule\n"
    col_names <- paste(c("Variable", "Mean", "SD", "P10", "Median", "P90", "N"),
                       collapse = " & ")
    body_lines <- apply(stats_dt, 1L, function(r) {
      paste(c(r[["Variable"]], r[["Mean"]], r[["SD"]],
              r[["P10"]],      r[["Median"]], r[["P90"]],
              r[["N"]]),
            collapse = " & ")
    })
    body <- paste(paste0(body_lines, " \\\\"), collapse = "\n")
    tex <- paste0(header,
                  col_names, " \\\\\n\\midrule\n",
                  body, "\n",
                  "\\bottomrule\n\\end{tabular}\n")
    out_tex <- file.path(tables_dir, paste0(file_stem, ".tex"))
    writeLines(tex, out_tex)
    cat("Wrote:", out_tex, "\n")
  }
}
```

```{r emit}
stats_big <- desc_stats_one(d_big, desc_vars_big)
stats_mid <- desc_stats_one(d_mid, desc_vars_keyrhs)
stats_sml <- desc_stats_one(d_sml, desc_vars_keyrhs)

emit_desc_panel(stats_big, "tab_descriptive_stats_big")
emit_desc_panel(stats_mid, "tab_descriptive_stats_mid")
emit_desc_panel(stats_sml, "tab_descriptive_stats_sml")
```

```{r summary}
# Quick chat summary: bucket sizes + base rate of opening.
sum_dt <- data.table(
  Bucket    = c(">=$100B", "$10B-$100B", "$1B-$10B"),
  N         = c(format(nrow(d_big), big.mark = ","),
                format(nrow(d_mid), big.mark = ","),
                format(nrow(d_sml), big.mark = ",")),
  `Mean(opening)` = sprintf("%.4f",
                            c(mean(d_big$opening, na.rm = TRUE),
                              mean(d_mid$opening, na.rm = TRUE),
                              mean(d_sml$opening, na.rm = TRUE)))
)
print(knitr::kable(sum_dt, format = "pipe"))
```
